sections.heading: For the people behind the numbers
sections.body:
FinSight provides conversational analysis and reporting over financial data. Its banking analytics bring financial insight and reporting analytics to the people who have to explain the number as well as produce it.

Combining advanced analytics and machine learning, FinSight is part of our [Data & AI](/services/data-ai) portfolio.
